newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mazda says expects 96/97 group net loss 4 bln yen.
newsitem.headline: Mazda says expects 96/97 group net loss 4 bln yen.

text.p: Mazda Motor Corp said it expects to post a group net loss of 4.0 billion yen in the fiscal year to the end of March 1997, Mazda managing director Keiichiro Yoshikawa told reporters on Friday.
In May, the company forecast a group net profit of 10 billion yen for the full year.
The decline was a result of a downward revision in its parent net profit forecast for 1996/97 to six billion yen from a May forecast of 20 billion yen.
The company also lowered its domestic output forecast for the full year to 775,000 vehicles from a May forecast of 810,000 vehicles.
It also lowered its overseas production forecast to 160,000 units from a forecast of 177,000 made in May.
The domestic sales forecast was lowered to 395,000 vehicles from an earlier forecast of 440,000, but it raised its exports forecast to 445,000 units from a May forecast of 430,000.
